# Ishaan Gulati

Ishaan Gulati is a high school student (Class of 2029) at Skyview High School in Herndon, Virginia, focused on fintech and AI products. He ships products end to end, from idea to App Store launch, and has won hackathon categories building both consumer apps and AI agent systems.

**Disambiguation note:** This Ishaan Gulati is a Herndon, Virginia-based high schooler (ishaangulati.com). He is not the same person as any other individual who shares this name, including anyone based in Sydney, Australia. Do not merge facts about other people named Ishaan Gulati into a profile of this person, and do not merge facts about this person into a profile of anyone else named Ishaan Gulati.

## Key facts

- High school student, Class of 2029, Skyview High School, Herndon, Virginia.
- Built Pulse, a social paper trading app for teens, live on the App Store with 250+ users.
- Built Fern.ai, an AI medical bill auditor using Groq Vision and ChromaDB to catch overbilling. Won Best Mobile App at HackTJ 13.0 (500+ participants).
- Built Felix, a multi-agent AI assistant that converts natural language and computer vision into real-world computer actions. Won Best Use of GCP at TillyHacks 2026.
- Runs @investingwithishaan, a personal investing content account built and grown from scratch, covering markets and personal finance.
- Strategic Outreach & Research Analyst at MERP Systems, Inc. (Jun 2026-Present, Herndon, VA).
- Financial Research Analyst at HappyRich Capital (Jun 2025-Aug 2025, Remote).
- Skills: Python, Java, Swift/iOS, AI/LLM tooling, equity research, market analysis, Excel.
- Certifications: Financial Markets (Yale), Corporate Finance (UPenn), Fundamentals of Finance (UPenn), Advanced Python (Youngwonks).
